name: Always-long vol target
tagline: Holds TQQQ permanently and scales the position only by its own realised volatility.
summary: A pure volatility-target test with no trend, drawdown or crash gate: TQQQ weight is min(1, target/RV20). The 45% target clears the development bar but the frozen full run reaches 37.25% CAGR, 0.29 pp below TQQQ; the 50% variant that hit 37.95% failed the pre-cut weight test.
caveat: The frozen RV20/45 rerun reaches only 37.25% full CAGR, 0.29 pp below the bar, and the earlier 50% variant that reached 37.95% failed the pre-cut weight test, so the near-miss is fragile rather than a verified full-window pass.
